name: Ahlatci Dogal Gaz Dagitim Enerji ve Yatirim A.S.
summary: Ahlatci Dogal Gaz Dagitim Enerji ve Yatirim A.S. engages in the wholesale, retail distribution, and sale of natural gas in Turkey. It also offers operational and consultancy services, as well as banking and finance services. The company was incorporated in 2004 and is based in Istanbul, Turkey. Ahlatci Dogal Gaz Dagitim Enerji ve Yatirim A.S. operates as a subsidiary of Ahlatci Holding A.S.
